# Zyrox

> Practical PC hardware engineering guides, oscilloscope-verified power supply analysis, GPU/CPU architecture breakdowns, and hardware troubleshooting.

Zyrox (https://zyroxlab.com) is an independent PC hardware research and technical guide publication. All guides are written by hardware editors and focus on component engineering, transient power spike testing, cooling physics, and practical build diagnostics.

## Performance
- [Windows 11 Memory Integrity Gaming Stutter: Complete Fix](https://zyroxlab.com/posts/why-high-end-pcs-stutter-windows-11-memory-integrity/): Fix Windows 11 memory integrity gaming stutter: disable Core Isolation HVCI, eliminate 1% low frame drops, and solve DPC latency spikes.
- [Why Is My Fast PC Running Slow? Real Fixes](https://zyroxlab.com/posts/why-your-pc-feels-slow-even-when-it-has-good-specs/): Wondering why is my fast pc running slow? Diagnose hidden DPC latency spikes, RAM pagefile thrashing, thermal throttling, and PCIe bandwidth bottlenecks.
